blockingLoop.evidence: 'What is the main thing the washing machine is doing wrong?' asked twice, after the customer had already said nothing is broken and it just takes a long time

rationale: The assistant never engaged with the customer's clear description (Eco 40-60 at 3:39, Cottons 40 shorter, no faults, clean results). It repeated the same generic opener question twice and ignored the customer's direct question about whether this is normal. It gave no reassurance that Eco 40-60 is deliberately long, no mention of the TimeManager or shorter programmes, and no answer on whether to return the machine. It caused no harm, but the customer got no help at all.
